values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (April-October) basic $15, electric/water 50A $32, family electric/water 50A $57; off-season (November-March) $14 / $26 / $47. Every electric site also has water, so the electric add-on (+$17 on-season, +$12 off-season) includes it. Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads) takes one reservation fee.

fees.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/01/onondaga-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('(April through October)', '(November through March)', 'Basic $15 $14', '*Electric/Water $32 $26 50 AMP', '*Family/Electric/Water $57 $47 50 AMP') + CampingFees_Onondaga_26.pdf (same figures), read 2026-11-07. Basic sites are 38-68 ft on the booking grid, so a 23-ft rig fits the basic base.

values.note: $2 a night off year-round for seniors 65+, persons with disabilities, military and veterans; ask at payment, with proof.

note: One campground of basic and electric/water sites strung up a wooded hollow off the Meramec River, the basic loop nearest the river. Open year-round; showers, water and reservations April 1-October 31, first come in winter, when potable water is at the canoe-launch spigot. Park gates may close after 11 p.m. in the on-season. --Claude
